title: Bisnis dan Kewirausahaan Era Digital
subtitle: Bisnis dan Kewirausahaan Era Digital
blurb: This Book explores how organizations can strategically navigate digital disruption by integrating technology, leadership, organizational agility, business model innovation, customer experience, digital operations, talent development, cybersecurity, and performance measurement. Academically grounded in contemporary business and entrepreneurship literature, this book provides a strategic framework for understanding and implementing digital transformation to create sustainable value, organizational resilience, and competitive advantage in an increasingly connected business environment.
